title: 5 Best Anime Duos: Iconic BFFs, Frenemies, Lovers, and Pets
content:
Half-demon warrior meets time-traveling schoolgirl. Inuyasha and Kagome blend action, romance, and spiritual growth in one of anime's most memorable duos. Their relationship grows from bickering allies to deeply connected partners in both love and battle.
Fighting monsters, recovering sacred shards, or just navigating their feelings, Inuyasha and Kagome prove that even clashing personalities can form a powerful, heartfelt team.
We created this article in conjunction with AI technology, then made sure it was fact-checked and edited by a HowStuffWorks editor.
